title: Covering systems with big moduli
exact_target: Can distinct covering systems have arbitrarily large minimum modulus? The historical question has a negative answer: Hough proves a uniform upper bound of $10^{16}$ for the least modulus. \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/1307.0874v3}{[S3]}
